text: As a virus [raises the dead across the United States|threat|the dead that rise] and Philadelphia descends into chaos, a traffic reporter, his pregnant girlfriend Fran and two SWAT officers [steal a television news helicopter and flee the city|trigger|running from trouble]. They come down on a shopping mall full of food and medicine, block its doors with trucks, and [hide a safe room behind a camouflaged stairwell|images|buildings and public places]. Life there turns indulgent, until a bite on Roger's arm reminds them that [whoever dies comes back|rules|the dead do not rest].
